summary: typescript, javascript npm package (Node server + Vite client). All 13 criteria pass.

criteria.notes: Biome lints and formats every .js, .mjs and .ts file outside dist/ (biome.jsonc tracked); package.json has "lint" (biome check --error-on-warnings .) and "format" scripts. 284 files pass with no suppression comments.
package.json "typecheck" runs tsc --noEmit on tsconfig.server.json and tsconfig.client.json (both extend strict tsconfig.base.json).
37 test files under tests/*.test.ts (268 tests), run by node:test through tsx.
package.json "build" runs vite build (client) then tsc -p tsconfig.server.json (server into dist/server).
AGENTS.md "Commands" and docs/guide.md "Development" document npm ci / npm install, build, lint, typecheck, tests and running bin/agent-office.js; "dev" and "start" scripts exist.
Root AGENTS.md plus nested src/server/AGENTS.md, src/client/AGENTS.md and src/shared/AGENTS.md. No CLAUDE.md adapters; Claude Code loads AGENTS.md natively.

.env.example lists every AGENT_OFFICE_* and PORT setting the office and installers read; tests/env-example.test.ts keeps it in sync with the code, and .gitignore ignores .env and .env.* except .env.example.

.github/workflows/release.yml runs npm ci (prepare builds), npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm run test:coverage on pull requests and main, then packs and install-smokes the release. No continue-on-error.

measurement.command: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage

criteria.notes: .husky/pre-commit runs lint-staged (biome check --write on staged files) and npm run typecheck; prepare installs it through .husky/install.mjs, skipped in CI and installs without dev dependencies.

package.json "test:coverage" runs node:test with --experimental-test-coverage and --test-coverage-lines=78 / --test-coverage-functions=61; release.yml runs it. Measured on Node 22: 80.22% lines, 71.95% functions.
package-lock.json is tracked for the root package.json, and src/client/package-lock.json for the src/client IWSDK shim; tests/iwsdk-shim.test.ts checks the shim pin matches the root lockfile.
Root .gitignore ignores node_modules, dist, .env files and IWSDK runtime state; no generated directories or env files are tracked.
